name: Arc Dash
objective: Switch rails to dodge four blockers!
hint: Tap anywhere to switch rails

name: Laser Tunnel
objective: Duck high lasers; stand over low lasers!
hint: Hold to duck, release to stand

name: Armor Repair
objective: Fit all three numbered armor plates!
hint: Drag plates onto matching numbers

name: Rocket Rescue
objective: Collect three friends and reach EXIT!
hint: Drag the rocket to steer

name: Flappy Bonus
objective: Fly through three open gates!
hint: Tap to flap; release to fall

name: Swing Rescue
objective: Leap onto the rescue mattress!
hint: Swipe right to launch; up adds height

name: Meteor Dodge
objective: Stay clear of falling meteors!
hint: Drag left and right

name: Parcel Catch
objective: Catch every falling parcel!
hint: Drag the wide basket underneath

name: Ice Slide
objective: Slide and stop inside the green ring!
hint: One long right swipe sets your speed

name: Rail Grind
objective: Jump over three rail barriers!
hint: Tap when each barrier approaches

name: Balloon Lift
objective: Float to the green rooftop!
hint: Hold to rise, release to sink

name: Magnet Haul
objective: Pull the scrap into its green home!
hint: Drag magnet near the box, then to SCRAP

name: Rope Bridge
objective: Follow the bridge through 1, 2, 3, 4!
hint: Drag along the wide bridge

name: Paint Skate
objective: Skate through every number in order!
hint: Drag from 1 through 4

name: Shield Surf
objective: Parry all three falling bolts!
hint: Swipe up after a bolt crosses gold

name: Boulder Push
objective: Push the rolling rock into PARK!
hint: Swipe right repeatedly

name: River Hop
objective: Hop onto four lily pads in order!
hint: Swipe toward the next pad

name: Glider Gust
objective: Catch the breeze to the island!
hint: Swipe up for a lifting gust

name: Orbit Escape
objective: Launch straight toward the space dock!
hint: Tap as your ship crosses the green ray

name: Spring Vault
objective: Charge your spring and land on green!
hint: Hold, then release in the green band

name: Cloud Ferry
objective: Pick up your friend and ferry them HOME!
hint: Drag cloud beneath friend, then HOME

name: Parachute Drop
objective: Land your parachute on the green platform!
hint: Drag left or right to steer

name: Pinball Rescue
objective: Bounce into the top three times!
hint: Tap when the ball is near the flippers

name: Conveyor Sort
objective: Deliver A and B parcels to matching bins!
hint: Drag each letter to its matching bin

name: Comet Curl
objective: Bank off gold, clear red, stop on green!
hint: Swipe diagonally up-right for a bank shot
